resume: FMDj runs Game Boy music programs on the FM-1: LSDj, the tracker, and DMGo!, the drum machine, in a Game Boy emulator, using its screen, keys, knobs and sound. You need your own ROM (.gb): nothing of LSDj or DMGo! is included.

commandes.role: LSDj's SELECT + DOWN: the screen below. OCT- and OCT+ held 5 s: update mode.
LSDj's SELECT + UP: the screen above.
The menu, on the lower half of the screen, music keeps playing: screen colors (DMG, POCKET, LIGHT, SGB, DARK), status bar, emulator options. GLO or B closes it. It is kept in flash.
START. The first press after power-on starts the program. In LSDj, a second plays the demo song. After power-on, PLAY loads the save.
Held one second: saves to the FM-1's flash (SAVING, then SAVED and the size).
LEFT and RIGHT (one click = one press, clockwise = RIGHT). With A held: changes a value by one.
LSDj's SELECT + LEFT or RIGHT: changes screen.
UP and DOWN (clockwise = DOWN). With A held: changes a value by one octave or 0x10.
LSDj: the top F (F5) is A, the top G (G5) is B. DMGo!: the 16 white keys are steps 1 to 16.
DMGo!: D#5 is A, F#5 is B.

gestes: A held (the top F) + SELECT or ALGORITHM: edit as in LSDj, by one step or one octave.
OCT- and OCT+ held 5 s: update mode.

modes.texte: UP and DOWN (ALGORITHM, SCL, SAVE) choose a row, LEFT, RIGHT (SELECT, HOME, ARP) or A change it: SCREEN, STATUS BAR, DRAW, ROM READ, WAIT LOOP, SOUND.
FPS (59.7: real time), CPU (below 100 % it keeps up), GAPS (the seconds where audio was missing).

a_savoir: LSDj is by Johan Kotlinski (littlesounddj.com). DMGo! is by Audiowanderer, free at audiowanderer.com. Only one of the two at a time: to switch, load the other ROM.
The FX, LFO, EDIT and ENV buttons do nothing.
